# Poor Sword: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10002/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Use case: stylized-concept Asset type: low-resolution fantasy RPG inventory item sprite for OpenYAMM Primary request: create a full-length inventory sprite of the MM9 Poor Sword shown in Image 1, redesigned for the tall MM6-MM8 inventory presentation shown in Image 2. Input images: Image 1 is the object-design reference; preserve its simple straight pale-steel blade, short dark grip, small gold crossguard, and modest inexpensive character. Image 2 is only the style, orientation, silhouette-scale, and late-1990s pre-rendered RPG reference. Subject: exactly one complete one-handed short sword, p CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): give the sword a full one-hand grip. From the bottom of the crossguard to the end of the pommel must be about 22-25% of the total length. The paperdoll hand closes over the grip, so the grip must be long enough for a fist plus a visible pommel, like MM6-MM8 swords (look at the style reference: their hilt below the guard is about a quarter of the length). Crossguard perfectly horizontal, at right angles to the blade..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Use case: stylized-concept Asset type: low-resolution fantasy RPG inventory item sprite for OpenYAMM Primary request: create a full-length inventory sprite of the MM9 Poor Sword shown in Image 1, redesigned for the tall MM6-MM8 inventory presentation shown in Image 2. Input images: Image 1 is the object-design reference; preserve its simple straight pale-steel blade, short dark grip, small gold crossguard, and modest inexpensive character. Image 2 is only the style, orientation, silhouette-scale, and late-1990s pre-rendered RPG reference. Subject: exactly one complete one-handed short sword, p CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): give the sword a full one-hand grip. From the bottom of the crossguard to the end of the pommel must be about 22-25% of the total length. The paperdoll hand closes over the grip, so the grip must be long enough for a fist plus a visible pommel, like MM6-MM8 swords (look at the style reference: their hilt below the guard is about a quarter of the length). Crossguard perfectly horizontal, at right angles to the blade.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10002/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Editing instructions: Image 1 is the exact paint_mask_guide.png EDIT TARGET. Images 2 and 3 are design_reference.png and icon_x8.png material references only. Preserve the guide geometry exactly; its existing hilt proportions govern, do not reshape. Output only the complete 3-column 4-row atlas, not a single inventory sword. Upper two rows textured unlit pale steel blade, brass gold crossguard, brown leather wrapped handle, steel pommel. Lower two rows identical geometry with pure red metal and pure green leather. Transparent outside all ten silhouettes. Exact guide alignment.
